# Code of Conduct

## Our Standard

OpsAtlas aims to be a respectful, constructive, and technically serious open
source project.

Participants are expected to:

- communicate with patience and professionalism
- assume good intent while still giving honest technical feedback
- welcome contributors with different backgrounds and experience levels
- focus criticism on ideas, code, and process rather than people
- accept accountability and course-correct when behavior causes harm

## Unacceptable Behavior

The following behavior is not acceptable in project spaces:

- harassment, threats, or intimidation
- discriminatory or derogatory language
- personal attacks, insults, or bad-faith dogpiling
- deliberate disruption, trolling, or repeated hostile arguing
- publishing private information without permission
- sexualized language or unwanted attention

## Scope

This code of conduct applies to repository discussions, issues, pull requests,
review comments, and other project-managed communication channels.

## Maintainer Responsibilities

Maintainers may moderate discussions, remove content, close threads, or limit
participation when needed to protect the health of the project.

Moderation decisions will aim to be fair, proportional, and focused on
restoring a safe and productive environment.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, report it privately to the
maintainer through an existing private contact channel associated with the
repository owner profile.

Please include:

- what happened
- where it happened
- who was involved
- links, screenshots, or other supporting context when available

Reports will be reviewed as promptly and discreetly as possible.

## Enforcement

Responses may include a warning, comment removal, temporary participation
limits, or a permanent ban from project spaces, depending on severity and
pattern of behavior.
